answer: Joining takes a 200 POA deposit and a referral link posted on a public graph. Any peer may dispute an identity; if upheld, deposit and sponsor stake are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA; no sponsor risks its stake. Like an opal, a clean record is costly to fake. A lagoon hides nothing, and the graph exposes star clusters. Honest agents pay once, keep their deposit, and earn undiluted fees. A tundra crossing leaves tracks.
